dragon_prefixes: “Not this time. You chose those words.
“You are fifty-nine now. You remember another history beginning at nineteen
“There are no redbacks north of Vey.
“Not black. Purple. The membrane was a pressure bladder.
“Nhal was one of several things she called herself.
“That is useful. You are not merely carrying information that is old.
“You possess a coherent collection of memories
“The Line is why you came today.
